001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Mobi drive-mechanism record, written at the start and end of each bolus, periodically during
009 * longer ones, and during cartridge retraction and fills; not seen on t:slim X2. Tandem publishes
010 * no name for opcode 277, so this class name is provisional. Only the drive counter is
011 * understood; the other fields are exposed raw. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/144.
012 */
013@HistoryLogProps(
014    opCode = 277,
015    displayName = "Pump Drive Event"
016)
017public class PumpDriveEventHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
018
019    private long driveCounter;
020    private int unknownI16At14;
021    private int unknownI16At16;
022    private int unknownU8At18;
023    private int unknownU8At19;
024    private int unknownU8At20;
025    private int unknownU8At21;
026    private int unknownU16At22;
027    private int unknownU16At24;
028
029    public PumpDriveEventHistoryLog() {}
030
031    public PumpDriveEventHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long driveCounter, int unknownI16At14, int unknownI16At16, int unknownU8At18, int unknownU8At19, int unknownU8At20, int unknownU8At21, int unknownU16At22, int unknownU16At24) {
032        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, driveCounter, unknownI16At14, unknownI16At16, unknownU8At18, unknownU8At19, unknownU8At20, unknownU8At21, unknownU16At22, unknownU16At24, 0);
033    }
034
035    public PumpDriveEventHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long driveCounter, int unknownI16At14, int unknownI16At16, int unknownU8At18, int unknownU8At19, int unknownU8At20, int unknownU8At21, int unknownU16At22, int unknownU16At24, int headerHighNibble) {
036        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
037        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, driveCounter, unknownI16At14, unknownI16At16, unknownU8At18, unknownU8At19, unknownU8At20, unknownU8At21, unknownU16At22, unknownU16At24, headerHighNibble);
038        this.driveCounter = driveCounter;
039        this.unknownI16At14 = unknownI16At14;
040        this.unknownI16At16 = unknownI16At16;
041        this.unknownU8At18 = unknownU8At18;
042        this.unknownU8At19 = unknownU8At19;
043        this.unknownU8At20 = unknownU8At20;
044        this.unknownU8At21 = unknownU8At21;
045        this.unknownU16At22 = unknownU16At22;
046        this.unknownU16At24 = unknownU16At24;
047    }
048
049    public int typeId() {
050        return 277;
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * <table border="1">
055     * <caption>Parsed fields for PumpDriveEventHistoryLog:</caption>
056     * <tr><td><code>driveCounter</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>unknownI16At14</code></td><td><code>(short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>unknownI16At16</code></td><td><code>(short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At18</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At19</code></td><td><code>raw[19] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At20</code></td><td><code>raw[20] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At21</code></td><td><code>raw[21] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>unknownU16At22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
064     * <tr><td><code>unknownU16At24</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
065     * </table>
066     */
067    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
068        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
069        this.cargo = raw;
070        parseBase(raw);
071        this.driveCounter = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
072        this.unknownI16At14 = (short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
073        this.unknownI16At16 = (short) Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
074        this.unknownU8At18 = raw[18] & 0xFF;
075        this.unknownU8At19 = raw[19] & 0xFF;
076        this.unknownU8At20 = raw[20] & 0xFF;
077        this.unknownU8At21 = raw[21] & 0xFF;
078        this.unknownU16At22 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
079        this.unknownU16At24 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
080    }
081
082    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long driveCounter, int unknownI16At14, int unknownI16At16, int unknownU8At18, int unknownU8At19, int unknownU8At20, int unknownU8At21, int unknownU16At22, int unknownU16At24, int headerHighNibble) {
083        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
084            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(277, headerHighNibble),
085            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
086            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
087            Bytes.toUint32(driveCounter),
088            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknownI16At14),
089            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknownI16At16),
090            new byte[]{ (byte) unknownU8At18, (byte) unknownU8At19, (byte) unknownU8At20, (byte) unknownU8At21 },
091            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknownU16At22),
092            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknownU16At24)));
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * @return the drive position counter. Between cartridge changes it only increases, by about
097     * 1,073-1,080 counts per unit delivered (bolus plus basal), so one count is roughly 0.93 mU;
098     * a bolus moves it by 54 counts per 0.05 U after the first 0.05 U. It runs backwards while the
099     * cartridge is retracted and forwards during fills. The same counter appears in
100     * PrimeInprocess (348) and opcodes 19 and 231.
101     */
102    public long getDriveCounter() {
103        return driveCounter;
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * @return bytes 14-15 as a signed int16. Meaning unknown: usually equal to bytes 16-17; at
108     * most 60 during bolus and basal steps (54 is one 0.05 U step), about 300 during fills,
109     * about -2000 during retraction.
110     */
111    public int getUnknownI16At14() {
112        return unknownI16At14;
113    }
114
115    /**
116     * @return bytes 16-17 as a signed int16. See {@link #getUnknownI16At14()}.
117     */
118    public int getUnknownI16At16() {
119        return unknownI16At16;
120    }
121
122    /**
123     * @return byte 18. Meaning unknown: 0x64, 0xC4 or 0x9C seen.
124     */
125    public int getUnknownU8At18() {
126        return unknownU8At18;
127    }
128
129    /**
130     * @return byte 19. Meaning unknown: 4 or 5, 0 in a few records.
131     */
132    public int getUnknownU8At19() {
133        return unknownU8At19;
134    }
135
136    /**
137     * @return byte 20. Meaning unknown: 2, or 12 in the last records of a retraction.
138     */
139    public int getUnknownU8At20() {
140        return unknownU8At20;
141    }
142
143    /**
144     * @return byte 21. Meaning unknown: 15, rarely 5.
145     */
146    public int getUnknownU8At21() {
147        return unknownU8At21;
148    }
149
150    /**
151     * @return bytes 22-23. Meaning unknown: 0xFFFF during most bolus and basal steps; roughly
152     * 250-490 during fills and retraction.
153     */
154    public int getUnknownU16At22() {
155        return unknownU16At22;
156    }
157
158    /**
159     * @return bytes 24-25. Meaning unknown: small values (mostly 5-20 during bolus steps, up to
160     * about 90 during retraction).
161     */
162    public int getUnknownU16At24() {
163        return unknownU16At24;
164    }
165}
